summary: Pearson plc furnished a Form 6-K containing a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification (the non-US equivalent of a Schedule 13G/13D stake disclosure). Artisan Partners Limited Partnership reported total holdings of 11.998% of voting rights (72,201,182 shares) as of 29-Oct-2026, down from a prior 12.010%, crossing the threshold downward; the change reflects an acquisition or disposal of voting rights. All voting rights are indirect, held via a discretionary investment-management mandate with no stated end date. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or transaction terms are disclosed. Watch for further stake changes or engagement signals.
